MUSIC VIDEOS

'BEBE'
Format: MKV | AVC / HEVC
Audio: (1) PCM: 24bit/96kHz | (2) E-AC3-JOC: 16bit/48kHz
Subs: (.ass) Soft subs / Korean & Romanized

'PIPE DOWN'
Format: MKV | AVC / HEVC
Audio: (1) PCM: 24bit/96kHz | (2) E-AC3-JOC: 16bit/48kHz
Subs: (.ass) Soft subs / Korean & Romanized

Note:
Dolby Atmos mix for the whole single album was made by me, made it with a lot of love because this is one of my fav singles from STAYC (Still better than what RADO did for the first 3 albums),
also this is my way to celebrate their 5th anniversary.
Also the quality in BEBE in both MV and the Atmos Mix are 10/10, you could easily mistake the MV as the Master.
Did my best in Pipe Down MV but there weren't any decent sources for the MV, still I think the result was pretty good.
Enjoy!
